name: package-modernize
description: Modernize an old published library end to end and release it again safely: survey, a golden capture of the published behaviour, a decisions-table plan that stops for the maintainer, a tested rewrite, an independent review, repository cleanup, a release rehearsal through trusted publishing with a human approval, registry verification and a handoff. npm and NuGet complete; PyPI, crates.io, Maven and Go documented and unverified. Nothing is published without the maintainer's approval. Evergreen.
